question: Which of the original's features matter most to the person (file data import, chart building with drag-and-drop shelves, dashboards, maps, database connections, sharing)?
resolution: The person left decisions to the builder. Chosen scope for v1: open CSV files plus a built-in sample, preview the data, build charts by dragging fields onto Columns/Rows/Marks shelves (bar, line, area, circle/scatter, square/heat map, text table, pie), filters, sorting, several sheets, a simple dashboard, and saving/opening workbooks. Maps, live database connections and publishing are left for later rounds.
